type I = { [k: `${number}`]: string };
type T = I[0];
function write(x: I) {
  x[1] = "a";
}
function read(x: I, n: number) {
  console.log(x[1].toUpperCase(), x[n]);
}
type A = { [k: `a${number}`]: string };
function readA(x: A) {
  const a: string = x["a1"];
  return x[1];
}
type IN = I[number];
const fromStringNames: I = { "0": 1 };
interface Y { [k: `${number}`]: string; "0": number }
const src = { "1": 2 };
const fromVariable: I = src;
function inferValue<T>(value: { [k: `${number}`]: T }): T {
  return value["1"];
}
const inferred: string = inferValue({ 0: 1, "1": true });
